concepts.label: Active Requests API (Analytics)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - GET /analytics/admin/active_requests, first contact. Distinct from n1ql:query-request-status-enum (a different service's status vocabulary) and from analytics:query-service-rest-api (which SUBMITS a query rather than listing running ones).

concepts.label: Request Cancellation API (Analytics)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - DELETE /analytics/admin/active_requests, first contact. A distinct HTTP method/operation on the same path as analytics:active-requests-api, cancelling a specific request by client_context_id rather than listing them.

concepts.label: Ingestion Status API (Analytics)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - GET /analytics/status/ingestion, first contact. Reports per-collection DCP ingestion progress; the modern replacement for analytics:pending-mutations-api.

concepts.label: Pending Mutations API (Analytics, deprecated)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - GET /analytics/node/agg/stats/remaining, first contact. Explicitly deprecated on this page ('This operation is deprecated, and will be removed in a future release'; 'this endpoint has been deprecated, and you should use the Ingestion Status endpoint instead').

concepts.label: Cluster Status API (Analytics)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - GET /analytics/cluster, first contact. Returns node/partition/replica topology and cross-links to the other Analytics REST surfaces (config, restart, service) via URI fields in its response body. Not the same object as analytics:query-plan-object or analytics:analytics-metrics-object (round 21/this round's query-response schemas) - this is cluster/topology state, not a query result.

concepts.label: Analytics Cluster Restart API
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - minted in round 21 (analytics/config.json, analytics/rest-analytics.json), both of which only cross-referenced this page by seeAlso without ever reading it. This page is the actual first-hand definition: POST /analytics/cluster/restart, restarting every Analytics node in the cluster.

notable_absence.finding: The page states the Pending Mutations endpoint 'is deprecated, and will be removed in a future release' and separately that it 'may not return meaningful results in Couchbase Server 7.0 and later', but never states a specific version in which the endpoint itself was DECLARED deprecated - the two facts (behavior degrades since 7.0; deprecated as a policy) are stated adjacently but not explicitly tied to the same version number, so no deprecatedIn relation was minted rather than inferring one.

cross_component_finding: This page is the first-hand source for analytics:cluster-restart-api and analytics:node-restart-api, both of which round 21 and this round's analytics-rest-config page had already minted purely from seeAlso cross-references without ever reading this page directly - their descriptions (restart scope, response codes, security roles) are attested here for the first time rather than merely cross-linked.
cross_product_finding: None found on this page - all monitoring/restart/cancellation operations are Analytics-Service-internal with no stated Capella or cross-product parallel.
